58738dee0a.substituent_description: A 3-chloro-2-fluorophenyl ring (C1 bears CH2-NH, F at C2 ortho to the CH2, Cl at C3 meta to the CH2) is linked via CH2NH-C(=O)-CH2-N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2 to the N1 of an indole. The indole carries an acetyl (Ac) at C3 and, at C5 of the benzo ring, a CH2-C(=O) group joined to the nitrogen of a piperidine ring that has two F atoms on the same carbon (3,3-difluoro, the carbon two atoms from N).
58738dee0a.notes: Typeset skeletal structure; three C=O, one indole C2=C3 and six Kekule double bonds in the two benzene rings.

4be595da7b.substituent_description: A pyrrolidine N is acylated as a urea C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2- to one nitrogen of a piperazine whose other nitrogen is bonded to a para-disubstituted benzene ring. The para position of that ring carries O-CH2 attached (hashed bond) to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane; the dioxolane C2 bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (Cl ortho and para to the attachment) and a CH2 (hashed bond) leading to N1 of an imidazole.
4be595da7b.notes: Typeset skeletal structure. Two hashed bonds on the dioxolane (one to the OCH2 carbon, one to the CH2-imidazole carbon). Double bonds: one C=O, three in each benzene ring, two in the imidazole.

4e89d6d1bb.substituent_description: A purine (fused 6-5 ring system with four N atoms) has COOtBu on the carbon between the two six-ring nitrogens (C2), H2N on C6, and N9 bonded through a solid wedge to a cyclohexane carbon. On that cyclohexane the adjacent carbon bears BocNH (hashed bond) and the carbon one further around the ring (1,3 to the NHBoc carbon, 1,4-related to the purine-bearing carbon) bears a hashed bond to CH2-CO2H.
4e89d6d1bb.notes: Typeset structure with condensed labels (COOtBu, BocNH, CO2H, H2N) on a skeletal framework. Four purine double bonds (two C=N in the six-ring, C=C fusion bond, C=N in the five-ring); carbonyls inside COOtBu and CO2H are not drawn as bonds.

14b36be44c.substituent_description: Chain from the top: H2N-C(=O)-HN-CH2CH2CH2-CH(wedge to chain carbon)-C(=O)-HN attached to a benzene ring; the CH is also bonded to NH-C(=O)-CH(NHBoc)(solid wedge to iPr). The benzene ring (circle) has the HN at C1, a CH2-OH at C4 (para) and a CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2 group at C3 (meta to HN, ortho to CH2OH); the carbamate O-CH2 is attached to C9 of a fluorene (two circled benzene rings joined by a five-membered ring).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The r in iPr is written like a gamma-shaped r
The amide NH is written stacked, N with H directly beneath it
14b36be44c.notes: Handwritten skeletal drawing in black pen on white paper. Two solid wedges: one from the Val-type alpha carbon to iPr and one from the second alpha carbon up to the chain CH2. All aromatic rings drawn with circles. The OH label is attached through a one-carbon CH2 stub.

8fd667f569.substituent_description: A ring (drawn with five vertices and three inner double lines) bears NH at one vertex, an F on the adjacent vertex (ortho to the NH carbon) and a second F on the next vertex (meta). The NH is acylated: NH-C(=O)-CH(hashed unlabelled methyl)-O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2-N, where N is the ring nitrogen of a benzene-fused six-membered ring containing N, O, CH2 and C(=O) (a benzoxazinone-type ring, N and O on adjacent benzo carbons).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The left aryl ring is drawn with only five vertices (a pentagon) although it has three inner double lines; it looks like an intended benzene ring
The H and N of the amide NH are written stacked, with H above N
The hashed bond is unlabelled and carries only a methyl end
8fd667f569.notes: Handwritten drawing in black pen on white paper. Described literally: the left ring has five ring atoms as drawn. Double bonds: three C=O (amide, ester, ring lactam), three inner lines in the left ring, three in the right benzene.

69cefac752.substituent_description: A benzene ring (circle) has OPh at one position and a CH2 chain at a position meta to it (1,3). The chain is ring-CH2-CH, and the CH carries NHBoc (plain bond, pointing up) and MeOOC (hashed bond, pointing left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The OO in MeOOC is overwritten and looks smudged
The hashed bond to MeOOC is drawn as a few vertical strokes with small ticks, so the hash count is rough
Ink is very dark purple-black on grey paper
69cefac752.notes: Handwritten drawing, photographed on grey paper. The ink looks dark purple or black, recorded as black. Small ink dots sit on some ring vertices.

2ab46bead4.substituent_description: A para-disubstituted benzene ring (circle) bears AcNH at C1 and a sulfonyl S(=O)2 at C4. The sulfonamide N carries a line to a CH2 vertex that ends in a Bn label, and CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH- leading to C3 of a pyrrole. The pyrrole has methyl groups at C2 and C5, and its N1 is bonded to a 2,4-dimethylphenyl ring (circle; methyls ortho and para to the attachment).
2ab46bead4.notes: Typeset structure. Both benzene rings are drawn as circles while the pyrrole uses alternating double bonds. Double bonds: two S=O, one C=O, one C=N, two in the pyrrole.

3c35c81739.substituent_description: A 4-methyl-1,2,4-triazole (N-Me, three N atoms) is joined through its carbon next to the N-Me to C4 of a benzene ring; that benzene has OEt at C2 (ortho to the NH) and NH at C1 (para to the triazole). The NH is bonded to the ring N (N-N link) of a bicyclic 6-6 system that has a methyl (unlabelled line) on the pyridine-type ring and an azetidine N attached at the carbon next to the ring fusion; the azetidine has an unlabelled gem-dimethyl carbon next to N and a MeO-bearing carbon next to that.
3c35c81739.notes: Typeset structure. The bicycle has a pyridine-like ring (N=C, two C=C) fused to a ring containing a CH2, the NH-bearing N and one C=C. Double bonds: two in the triazole, three in the benzene, four in the bicycle.

478fcf2668.substituent_description: A piperidine ring has EtO on C4 (solid wedge) and, on C2 next to N, a hashed bond to a circled benzene ring. That benzene ring carries, relative to the piperidine attachment at C1, an O-CH2CH2CH2-NHAc chain at C2 (ortho) and HO2C at C4 (para). The piperidine N is bonded through a CH2 to C4 of an indole (circled benzo ring) bearing MeO at C5 and an unlabelled methyl at C7, with NH in the five-membered ring and a drawn C2=C3 double bond.
478fcf2668.notes: Handwritten drawing in black pen on white paper. Benzene rings drawn with circles; the only Kekule-style double bond is the indole five-membered ring C=C.
